|lore='Perhaps you think you're being treated unfairly?' 'No.' 'Good. It would be unfortunate if I had to leave a garrison here.'
|game_text=If you control two Cloud City sites and opponent controls none, deploy on [Special Edition] Bespin system. At related sites where you have an alien/Imperial pair, your Force drains are +1 and, if you just won a battle there, may take any card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Dark Deal (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Dark Deal (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 21 July 2024<ref name="ht-63a0ee1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual23-Dark/large/darkdeal.gif</code> as published 21 July 2024: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/63a0ee1a7d7c0170dd5d75d69fefd6d973cd8f47/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/darkdeal.gif holotable commit 63a0ee1] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “If you control two Cloud City sites and opponent controls none, deploy on [Special Edition] Bespin system. At related sites where you have an alien/Imperial pair, your Force drains are +1 and, if you just won a battle there, may take any card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Dark Deal (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 2 August 2024: “If you control two Cloud City sites and opponent controls none, deploy on [Special Edition] Bespin system. At related sites where you have an alien/Imperial pair, your Force drains are +1 and, if you just won a battle there, may take any card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Dark Deal (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Dark Deal”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Dark Deal (V)]] (published 21 July 2024) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Dark Deal]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
